_about: Fabric and interlining presets (core/fabric.py). A garment copies the numbers when a preset is picked, so editing this table never changes a saved garment. Each entry's source says where its numbers come from.
bend_hyst_source: kappa_y = 2HB / 2B, the curvature up to which a bend stays (the bending hysteresis; solver bend_fric2). This value: cotton broadcloth, KES B 0.06 gf cm2/cm and 2HB 0.05 gf cm/cm (general values; a measured unfinished cotton plain weave gives 34-38 /m, Utkun 2021). Written into a fabric that has none (core/fabric.migrate: the value the solver used for it before 2026-10-20).

fabrics.name: Cotton Poplin
fabrics.source: a new garment's default before 0.2.0. stretch: the membrane every garment had before 2026-10-20 (checked against a measured drape), not a KES conversion (an unfinished cotton plain weave, Utkun 2021: secant 650 N/m at 1 %, 3200 at 3 %); shear: cotton shirting KES G 0.52 gf/(cm deg) x 56.2 (Fibre2Fashion / Ramaiah et al.: 0.52); bend_hyst: cotton broadcloth (see bend_hyst_source; a measured shirting 51 /m, Ramaiah et al.); bending: shirtings 96-170 g/m2 measured 2.5-12.7 uN m (FAST B; Yick et al. quoted in Ancutiene et al. 2010), the middle; weight: a published poplin preset's; thickness (the display only): cotton shirting plain weave 125 g/m2 KES T 0.61 mm (Ramaiah et al., fabric C, the shear's fabric)

fabrics.name: Wool Suiting
fabrics.source: stretch, shear, bend_hyst: no source for wool yet -- the values every garment had before 2026-10-20 (cotton's); bending: wool/PA 244-251 g/m2, FAST B warp 17-25 / weft 11-19 uN m (Ancutiene et al. 2010, table 2), the mean; weight: a published wool preset's; thickness (the display only): the same wool/PA fabrics KES T 1.01-1.16 mm (Ancutiene et al. 2010, table 1), the mean

fabrics.name: Cotton Jersey
fabrics.source: a T-shirt's single jersey, cotton 100 %, dyed and unfinished (Ramaiah et al., fibre2fashion, KES-FB, fabric A): weight 125.5 g/m2, thickness 0.92 mm (the display only), bending KES B 0.0066 gf cm2/cm x 98.07, shear G 0.47 gf/(cm deg) x 56.2, bend_hyst 2HB/2B 61 /m; stretch: the poplin's 3000 x the ratio of the two fabrics' secants at 3 % (F = 490 N/m (eps/EM)^n, n = 2/LT - 1; jersey LT 0.632, EM about 21 %: 242 N/m; shirting fabric C LT 0.597, EM 6.6 %: 2560 N/m), both ways (the source gives no wale / course split)

fabrics.name: Rib Knit
fabrics.source: one layer of a 1x1 rib (2026-11-02, replaces 'Rib Knit (folded)', the one sheet that stood for a rib folded in two): half of each number of that sheet (stretch 30 N/m, shear 29 N/m, bending 12 uN m, weight 440 g/m2, thickness 1.5 mm), so a rib folded in two with Fold and both layers kept is that sheet again (two loose layers add; estimate, not run). No measured rib found yet (KES of a 1x1 cotton rib); bend_hyst: the table's

fabrics.name: Leather
fabrics.source: cowhide for bags, 9 leathers 1.05-1.30 mm measured on KES-FB (Roh 2020, J. Eng. Fibers Fabrics 15, doi 10.1177/1558925020968825, Table 3 mean): weight 706 g/m2, thickness 1.21 mm, bending B 2.67 gf cm2/cm x 98.07 (SD 1.40: 125-400 uN m), shear G 12.52 gf/(cm deg) x 56.2, bend_hyst 2HB/2B = 2.32/(2 x 2.67) = 43 /m; stretch: KES's 500 gf/cm (490 N/m) over EM 4.13 % (a secant at the maximum load, not at 3 %). A tote of it stands: the shape changes little above a bending length of 2.5 cm, and this is 3.4 cm

fabrics.name: Synthetic Leather
fabrics.source: PU-coated polyester for bags, 7 materials 1.02-1.20 mm measured on KES-FB (Roh 2020, J. Eng. Fibers Fabrics 15, doi 10.1177/1558925020968825, Table 3 mean, 'artificial'): weight 440 g/m2, thickness 1.11 mm, bending B 1.14 gf cm2/cm x 98.07, shear G 8.00 gf/(cm deg) x 56.2, bend_hyst 2HB/2B = 0.91/(2 x 1.14) = 40 /m; stretch: 490 N/m over EM 13.36 % (a secant at the maximum load)

fabrics.name: Canvas
fabrics.source: estimate, not measured (no measured bending, shear or stretch of a cotton canvas found). Weight: cotton duck No. 12, 390 g/m2 (numbered duck weights); thickness: a measured cotton duck, 0.72 mm (HardwareX 2023). Bending: a bending length c of 4 cm (D = 9.807e-3 x weight x c^3 uN m; measured heavy denims 2.9-3.8 cm, PMC8646987; a bag leather 3.4 cm). A tote stands for any c from 2.5 to 5 cm (2 cm and below folds down), so the guess decides little. Stretch and shear: guesses (the shape barely moved from 10000 to 65000 N/m); bend_hyst: the table's. Measure your canvas: slide a 2.5 cm strip over a table edge until its tip drops to 41.5 degrees; c is half the overhang

interlinings.name: Fusible Tricot
interlinings.source: estimate, not measured: a poplin collar with it at 60 uN m (6 + 54, x10; fused collars measured 6-34x the shell, a 2018 HUST study read from its abstract only); weight: a typical light tricot fusible
